literal_meaning: ফাটল কাটা (crack or split to cut)
figurative_meaning_en: to make snide or interrupting remarks
example_sentences_in_bangla: সভায় সে অনবরত ফুট কেটে চলল।
বন্ধুদের কথার মাঝে ফুট কেটে তার মতামত জানাল।
example_sentences_in_english: He kept making snide remarks throughout the meeting.
She interrupted the conversation with cutting comments among friends.
note: Refers to verbal interruptions in everyday Bengali discourse
